Nina (PMM): Quick heads-up — Atlas EV customer interview is scheduled for tomorrow 10:30am PT. We want a short written quote, legal sign-off, and to slot them into the June 15 product webinar. Who can own the approvals and routing?
Maya (Content): I can own the quote draft and asset collection. Will push a first pass today.
Sam (CS): I’ll sync with the customer on the demo notes and make sure they’re comfortable with the webinar flow. Also confirm embargo preferences.
Nina (PMM): Embargo ask: they want the case published only after their funding announcement on Jun 16 — so webinar on Jun 15 needs to be careful (preview vs public). Can marketing run a gated webinar and only publish replay post-embargo?
Liam (Growth): Yes we can gate the webinar and route registrants to AE handoff. Routing: mark leads from this webinar as "atlas-ev-case" and assign to @Liam and @Sam's queue.
Jules (Legal): Please send the exact proposed quote and the transcript after the interview. I need at least 24 hours to review redlines. Also confirm speaker full names and titles for the legal release.
Maya (Content): Draft quote below — feel free to redline: "Redwood Inference reduced inference costs by 38% and cut median latency by 40% for Atlas EV’s in-vehicle assistant, enabling faster OTA updates."
Jules (Legal): Quick redline: replace "reduced" with "reduced, on average" and change "cut" to "lowered". Also request customer sign-off line: "Customer approves this quote for public release."
Maya (Content): Got it — will update and send to Atlas for approval after the interview.
Sam (CS): Atlas asked if we can keep the replay private until Jun 16. That's fine. For the live webinar on Jun 15 we can do a closed audience (invite-only), then open replay Jun 16.
Liam (Growth): For lead routing: pipeline tag = "campaign/atlas-ev-launch". Can we have Sales Ops create that tag and a smart list for AEs?
Maya (Content): Asset checklist I'm collecting: final quote, approved headshots, 2 short soundbites (30-60s), transcript, one technical diagram. Will drop in the shared folder when ready.
Jules (Legal): Also need NDA appendix? If they ask for any redactions post-interview we need quick turnaround. Sam — can you get a firm contact from Atlas for sign-off?
Sam (CS): Yes — point of contact is Elena Morris (VP Eng). I’ll ask for formal approval email during the call.
webinar-bot: Calendar invite created: "Atlas EV - Customer Spotlight (Recording)" 2024-06-10 10:30 PT, meeting link + recording enabled.
Maya (Content): Can someone QA the recording/zoom setup 10 minutes before? I’ll handle slides and the intro.
Liam (Growth): I'll set up the registration page gated with an email verification step and ensure AE handoff flows are in place.
Nina (PMM): Timeline recap: Interview (recording) 6/10; Legal review complete by 6/11; Marketing assets finalized 6/12; Webinar (closed) 6/15; Replay public 6/16 after Atlas press. If anyone hits blockers ping here or DM.
Maya (Content): Thanks — will post the draft quote + slide deck link in this thread when uploaded. :thumbsup:
